messages:
Elena Ruiz: FYI urgent approval pls. GalaxyTx signed a 12-month dedicated GPU commit (monthly reserved fee) but vendor GPU shipment delay delayed their prod launch; they only used 40% of reserved hours in April. Sales is asking for a carveout/credit + a 2-month temporary overage discount while they finish infra. Can we approve before COB?

Elena Ruiz: Quick numbers: commit = 3x A100 nodes reserved (monthly fee $18,000). April actual utilization billed as reserved but effective usage suggests a fair pro-rate credit. Proposal: apply a 20% credit to April reserved fee = $3,600, plus 25% discount on overage (if any) for May+June.

Jonah Park: Need to confirm whether we treat reserved fee as non-refundable (standard) vs business goodwill. Also check ARR/upsell risk if we deny.

Elena Ruiz: Sales says low churn risk; they're strategic genomics partner and roadmap includes more workload next quarter. They requested goodwill relief to keep momentum.

Maya Chen: My approval boundary: up to $5k credit for Deal Desk. Anything above goes to VP Finance. This is $3,600 so within my authority, but we need Legal to sign a short addendum that this is a one-time concession and not recurring.

Liam O'Connor: If approved, shall we issue a credit memo or apply it as an invoice adjustment? Accounting prefers credit memo CM-GT-0426 for audit trail and GL 4-210-credits. Also need a note that this is a strategic concession.

Ava (Legal): Draft suggestion: "Redwood Inference agrees to issue a one-time credit of $3,600 applied to invoice GT-2026-04. In addition, Customer will receive a 25% discount on any billed overage charges incurred during the next two billing cycles (May 2026 and June 2026). This concession is a goodwill, one-time allowance and does not amend the underlying committed capacity agreement. It is not transferable and does not stack with other promotions. Customer must confirm acceptance by replying to the Redwood contact email within 5 business days."

Maya Chen: Language looks good. I approve the $3,600 credit memo and the 25% overage discount for May+June conditioned on customer acceptance email and Legal addendum. Liam 12 please create CM and ticket. Mark GL 4-210-credits and tag as Q2 strategic concessions.

Liam O'Connor: Creating credit memo CM-GT-0426 and ticket FIN-4338 now. Scheduling application for the next billing run. finance-bot created FIN-4338

finance-bot: Ticket FIN-4338 created by Liam O'Connor 12 Credit memo CM-GT-0426 $3,600 for GT-2026-04, GL 4-210-credits. Addendum requested: 25% overage discount for May+June pending customer ack.

Elena Ruiz: I'll send the addendum and attach the customer's acceptance to the ticket. Thanks all for quick turn.

Jonah Park: Note for records: please file clause in concessions register and make sure to mark this as a one-off. If customer asks to extend, re-escalate to VP Finance.

Maya Chen: Closing: approved, CM created, Legal addendum required, acceptance email needed. Tag: "Q2 strategic concessions" :white_check_mark:
